title: Dual-Flow Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
abstract: arXiv:2608.12385v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models serve more requests, cumulative inference cost is becoming increasingly important relative to one-time training cost. The two inference phases stress hardware differently: prompt prefill is parallel and typically compute-bound, whereas autoregressive decode is sequential and often memory-bandwidth-bound. Conventional width or depth scaling increases both costs together because every added layer is evaluated in both phases. We ask whether additional learned computation can instead be allocated to continuation prediction while preserving the prompt-wide primary computation and a single persistent key-value (KV) cache. We introduce the Dual-Flow Transformer. Its primary flow is a complete causal language model that processes the prompt and writes the KV cache. translated_title: 双流变压器：将主要预填充路径与额外解码计算解耦
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12385v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着大型语言模型服务更多请求，累积推理成本相对于一次性训练成本变得越来越重要。两个推理阶段对硬件的压力不同：提示预填充是并行的，通常受计算限制，而自回归解码是顺序的，通常受内存带宽限制。传统的宽度或深度扩展会同时增加这两种成本，因为每个添加的层在两个阶段都会被评估。我们询问是否可以将额外的学习计算分配给续接预测，同时保留提示宽度的主要计算和单一持久键值（KV）缓存。我们引入了双流变压器。其主流是一个完整的因果语言模型，处理提示并写入KV缓存。辅助流在提示处理期间被省略，仅从最终提示位置开始激活，增加续接预测计算，而不会增加预填充阶段的负担。
tldr: 该论文提出双流变压器架构，通过将辅助计算流仅用于解码阶段而不影响预填充，从而在不增加提示处理成本的情况下提升续接预测性能，并保持单一KV缓存。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Dual-Flow Transformer, which decouples auxiliary computation to the decode phase only, enhancing continuation prediction without increasing prefill cost while maintaining a single KV cache.
